# Per-file line-coverage floor for ratchet enforcement.
#
# Format: <path><TAB><min_percent>
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Rules:
#   - Coverage CI job (lint-extra.yml) FAILS if any listed file drops
#     below its floor.
#   - Floors only ratchet UP. When a PR genuinely raises a file's
#     coverage, update the floor in the same PR so the new level
#     becomes the new minimum and prevents future regression.
#   - Files not listed here are unconstrained — add a path the first
#     time you ship meaningful tests for it.
#
# Current floors were captured at branch fc7c4e6 (post per-bug-class
# unit tests). The values reflect the present measurement minus a
# small safety margin to absorb measurement noise without false
# positives.
src/vmm/serial.rs	67
src/virtio/vsock.rs	34
src/vmm/agent_listener.rs	17
src/control/protocol.rs	94
src/virtio/block.rs	62
